question: What is Sharp Quiz?
answer: Sharp Quiz is a mobile quiz app for programming skills, general knowledge, current affairs, and exam practice. It is published by ResilienceSoft.

question: Where can I download Sharp Quiz?
answer: Download Sharp Quiz on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sharpquiz&hl=en-IN The website also has a QR code and a DOWNLOAD APP button.

question: Which programming languages does Sharp Quiz cover?
answer: The website FAQ names PHP, React Native, .NET, and Angular. The Google Play listing also names React, C#, Python, Java, C, and C++.

question: Does Sharp Quiz have an AI quiz generator?
answer: The Google Play listing describes an AI Topic Quiz Generator: enter a topic and the app generates questions. It also describes a Document to Quiz Generator that creates questions from an uploaded PDF.

question: Which exams does Sharp Quiz mention?
answer: The Google Play listing says current affairs and daily quizzes are designed for UPSC, SSC, Banking, Railway, and State Government Exams.

question: How do I contact Sharp Quiz?
answer: Privacy-policy questions on the website go to sharpquiz@gmail.com. Google Play lists support email sharpquizapp@gmail.com. The developer on Play is RESILIENCESOFT, info@resiliencesoft.com, +91 91099 11372. The website also has a Contact us form (first name, last name, 10-digit phone, email).

question: Does Sharp Quiz sell my personal information?
answer: The website privacy policy says Sharp Quiz does not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties without consent. It may disclose information when required by law.

question: Who makes Sharp Quiz?
answer: The website footer says Powered By ResilienceSoft (https://www.resiliencesoft.com/). Google Play lists the developer as RESILIENCESOFT, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh.
